question_text: How many minutes are in 3.5 hours?

hint_ladder.title: Conversion Factor
hint_ladder.text: 1 hour = 60 minutes. 'Yan ang basic conversion na dapat kabisado.

hint_ladder.title: Answer
hint_ladder.text: So 3.5 hours = 210 minutes. Piliin ang D.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you converted only the 3 hours, forgetting the 0.5. Palagi mong i-check ang decimal.

B.text: You might have chosen B because of a miscalculation. Double-check your arithmetic para sigurado.

C.text: You might have chosen C because of a miscalculation. Double-check your arithmetic para sigurado.

next_time_rule: Kapag oras to minuto, i-multiply sa 60. 'Yung .5 hour, 30 minutes agad. Tandaan para 'di ma-trap!
deconstruct_text:
Alam mo ba na sa LGU, ang overtime pay ay kinocompute sa minuto? Kunwari, nag-overtime si Kagawad ng 3.5 oras. Kailangan mong malaman: ilang minuto 'yun? Ganito ang gawin:

1 oras = 60 minuto. Multiply 3.5 × 60.
Break it down: 3 oras = 180 minuto, 0.5 oras = 30 minuto. Total = 210 minuto.

Simple lang: 3.5 × 60 = 210. Tama!
